META ADS ENGINE
Campaigns built to close, not just collect clicks.

Audience targeting, ad creative, campaign structure, landing pages, WhatsApp flow, optimization, and reporting working together.

WHY META ADS MATTER
Most businesses waste ad budget because campaigns are not built to convert.

Clicks alone do not grow your business. A profitable Meta Ads campaign needs the right offer, the right audience, scroll-stopping creative, strong follow-up, and a conversion path that makes action easy.

CREA8IV SYSTEM
We build Meta Ads systems, not random ads.

Every campaign is engineered from audience targeting to creative to landing page to WhatsApp conversion flow so your business gets qualified leads at a predictable cost every month.

OUR META ADS PROCESS
A complete launch-to-scale campaign system.
01

We validate your offer before spending a single rupee so campaigns have a stronger chance to convert.

02

Detailed targeting by location, income signal, behavior, interest, and local market intent.

03

Scroll-stopping visuals and copy designed to capture attention and create action.

04

05

06

We scale what works, kill what does not, and report CPL, ROAS, leads, and conversion data.

CAMPAIGN CONTROL
Ads, creative, audience, and WhatsApp follow-up working as one system.

Meta Ads perform better when every step after the click is planned before launch.

WHAT MAKES US DIFFERENT
Layered campaigns beat broad boosting.

Most agencies launch a basic ad, select broad interests, and wait. We create multiple ad variations, test them simultaneously, and integrate WhatsApp automation so every lead is responded to within 60 seconds.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
Straight answers before you spend on Meta Ads.
What is the minimum ad budget required for Meta Ads in Pakistan?
+

We recommend a minimum monthly ad spend of PKR 30,000-50,000 to generate statistically meaningful data and consistent leads. Campaigns with lower budgets can run, but optimization is limited.

How quickly do Meta Ads start generating leads?
+

Well-structured campaigns in Rawalpindi typically start generating leads within 3-7 days. The first 2 weeks are the learning phase, while weeks 3-4 usually show stronger performance.

Can you send leads directly to WhatsApp?
+

Yes. We specialize in Click-to-WhatsApp campaigns and can integrate WhatsApp Business API with automated response flows so every new lead receives an instant reply with your offer details, pricing, or booking link.

META ADS — EXPLAINED

Meta Ads in Rawalpindi & Islamabad

Meta Ads are paid Facebook, Instagram, Messenger and WhatsApp campaigns run through Meta Ads Manager. For Rawalpindi & Islamabad businesses, they're the fastest way to put a qualified buyer in your WhatsApp — when the offer, targeting and funnel are built correctly.

Strategy & Content by Syed Qamar Abbas

Founder & CEO, Crea8iv Media

Frequently Asked Questions
How much do Meta Ads cost in Pakistan?

Meta Ads management at Crea8iv Media starts from PKR 25,000/month plus ad spend. Most Rawalpindi & Islamabad businesses need a minimum ad budget of PKR 20,000–50,000/month to generate consistent, qualified leads.

How quickly will I see results from Meta Ads?

Most campaigns produce leads within the first 7–14 days. The first 2–4 weeks are a learning phase; after that we optimize weekly to lower cost per lead and grow volume.

Do Meta Ads work for WhatsApp lead generation?

Yes — it's our specialty. We build click-to-WhatsApp campaigns that send qualified buyers straight to your inbox, then add ManyChat automation for an instant 24/7 reply.

What's the minimum budget to run Meta Ads?

We recommend PKR 20,000–50,000/month in ad spend for Rawalpindi & Islamabad businesses, plus the management fee. Smaller budgets work for testing but need more time to optimize.

What's the difference between boosting a post and Meta Ads?

Boosting is basic reach with limited targeting. Professional Meta Ads use full Ads Manager — custom audiences, conversion objectives, A/B testing and retargeting — which is what actually drives qualified leads.

Why choose Crea8iv Media for Meta Ads in Rawalpindi?

We're a Rawalpindi-based performance agency that builds WhatsApp-first lead systems, not just ads. We connect strategy, creative, tracking, landing pages and follow-up so Meta Ads leads are easier to measure and scale.
